en.title: About Me
description: I'm a Computer Science graduate from BINUS University with a strong foundation in web development and technical support. Currently working as a Web Developer Intern at PERURI (Perusahaan Umum Percetakan Uang Republik Indonesia), where I develop and maintain internal applications that serve hundreds of users daily.

My approach combines technical proficiency with a user-focused mindset. I believe great software isn't just about clean code—it's about solving real problems and making systems accessible to everyone.

With experience in full-stack development using Laravel and MySQL, I'm also expanding my skill set with React to build more dynamic, modular interfaces. Beyond coding, I enjoy troubleshooting, writing clear documentation, and ensuring smooth user experiences.
currentFocus: Building scalable web applications with Laravel & MySQL
Developing reusable React components for modern UIs
Improving system monitoring and internal tooling
Growing expertise in endpoint management and technical support

id.title: Tentang Saya
description: Saya lulusan Computer Science dari Universitas BINUS dengan fokus pada pengembangan web dan dukungan teknis. Saat ini bekerja sebagai Web Developer Intern di PERURI (Perusahaan Umum Percetakan Uang Republik Indonesia), di mana saya mengembangkan dan memelihara aplikasi internal yang melayani ratusan pengguna setiap hari.

Pendekatan saya menggabungkan kemampuan teknis dengan pola pikir yang berfokus pada pengguna. Saya percaya bahwa software yang baik bukan hanya tentang kode yang rapi—tetapi tentang menyelesaikan masalah nyata dan membuat sistem dapat diakses oleh semua orang.

Dengan pengalaman dalam full-stack development menggunakan Laravel dan MySQL, saya juga memperluas keahlian saya dengan React untuk membangun interface yang lebih dinamis dan modular. Selain coding, saya senang melakukan troubleshooting, menulis dokumentasi yang jelas, dan memastikan pengalaman pengguna yang lancar.

projects.title: Attendance Monitoring Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Real-time employee attendance tracking system
projects.overview: A comprehensive web-based dashboard for monitoring employee attendance across multiple departments. The system handles check-ins, check-outs, late arrivals, and generates automated reports for HR and management teams.
features: Real-time attendance tracking with automatic timestamp recording
Role-based dashboard views (Employee, Manager, HR, Admin)
Automated daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports
Late arrival notifications and absence tracking
Export functionality (PDF, Excel) for payroll integration
projects.role: Full-stack development - from database design to frontend implementation. Handled user requirements gathering, system architecture, coding, testing, and deployment.
impact: Reduced manual attendance processing time by 80%
Improved attendance accuracy and reporting reliability

projects.title: Visitor Log System
projects.subtitle: Secure visitor management with access control
projects.overview: A digital visitor management system that replaces traditional logbooks, enabling secure check-in/check-out processes with photo capture, purpose tracking, and host notifications.
features: Digital visitor registration with photo capture
QR code-based check-in for returning visitors
Visitor badge generation with unique IDs
Security clearance levels and restricted area management
Comprehensive visitor analytics and history logs
projects.role: Primary developer responsible for backend logic, database schema design, and integration with existing security systems. Collaborated with security team for requirements and testing.
impact: Enhanced security with digital audit trails
Reduced check-in time from 5 minutes to under 1 minute

projects.title: Internal Monitoring Tools
projects.subtitle: System health and performance dashboard
projects.overview: A centralized monitoring dashboard that provides real-time insights into application performance, server health, and user activities across multiple internal systems.
features: Real-time server performance metrics (CPU, RAM, disk usage)
User activity logs and session tracking
API endpoint health checks and response time monitoring
Automated incident reports and error logging
projects.role: Backend development and data aggregation logic. Created efficient monitoring queries and implemented alert systems for critical thresholds.
impact: 95% reduction in system downtime through proactive alerts
Faster incident response time (from hours to minutes)
Improved system reliability across all internal applications
